_note: Invented rules for the complaint agent (Amine). Levels decide the deadline (hours) a case must be answered in. Clusters are the root causes a complaint is filed under: `rx` finds them in the customer's words, `cause` is the kind of root cause (the same families as the quality analyst), `actions` is what the team usually does first.

billing_duplicate.label: Billing duplicates
billing_duplicate.action: Check the billing history, refund the duplicate and confirm it in writing.

billing_amount.label: Bill amount disputed
billing_amount.action: Go through the bill line by line with the customer and correct what is wrong.

roaming.label: Roaming activation
roaming.action: Check the roaming activation, credit the days lost and make sure the pass is active.

contract_terms.label: Contract terms and fees
contract_terms.action: Explain the contract terms, check if a waiver applies and offer a retention option.

network.label: Network and service quality
network.action: Open a technical ticket for the area, give a date for the fix and offer a credit for the lost service.

data_usage.label: Data usage
data_usage.rx: data (finished|ran out|is gone|limit|usage)|ran out of data|consumed (all )?my data|used (all )?my data|usage (is|was) wrong
data_usage.action: Check the real usage with the customer and explain how the allowance works.

repeat_contact.label: Repeat contact, nothing solved
repeat_contact.rx: (second|third|fourth|2nd|3rd|4th|fifth) (time|contact|call)|again and again|still (not|no)|nobody (called|got back)|no one (called|got back)|promised (me )?a call ?back|never called back
repeat_contact.action: Give the case one owner, call the customer back and do not transfer again.

conduct.label: Advisor conduct
conduct.rx: \brude\b|shouted|hung up on me|insult|disrespect|transferred (me )?(again|twice|three)|nobody (helped|listened)|did not listen|didn't listen
conduct.action: Apologise, review the call with the quality analyst and coach the advisor.

device.label: Device or SIM
device.action: Check the order or the replacement and give a delivery date.

signals.repeat: (second|third|fourth|fifth|2nd|3rd|4th|5th) (time|contact|call)|again and again|still (not|no)|nobody (called|got back)|no one (called|got back)|promised (me )?a call ?back|never called back|for (weeks|months|days)
